card.name: Section numbers in parentheses
card.fires_on: A number inside parentheses, or the closing parenthesis right after it, that cites a label section (such as 2.1, 4, 5.1) or a percentage count in a table. It fires at the number or the closing bracket, just before the next heading or value.

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a label section number, right before a section title or the next statement.

modes.label: Count with percent in tables
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a count or percent in a results table, before the next paired value.

card.plain: It marks the end of a small number in brackets, like a section reference or a count in a table, just before the next item begins.
